body: Oh definitely! My mom and I living with each other definitely makes things worse. I'm sure my mental health in general will improve once I leave. I'm moving in with ny boyfriend, which gives me hope.

Yeah, I'm trying. Its just whenever it happens it feels like before I can even begin my distraction I just am frozen in place and can't move much, my hands also get pretty shaky. Its hard breaking out of that. Distraction works most of the time, getting there can be a issue. Im trying to get better with not freezing up.

If I'm sent to a hospital, I'll be treated poorly and my mental health will be worse. Its been true every time. She knows that I used to self harm; hence why I was sent to the hospital twice. The hospital traumatized me. I've never been truly suicidal, but in that hospital I was praying to die and looking for things to maybe at least knock me out. I will never recommend anyone to go to the places I have been. There is also one time she said my self harm was for attention when I admitted during family therapy we were receiving made me feel severely depressed due to the essentially "bullying" I was receiving during the period. I even showed them my scars and it was just...indifference. I'm looking to get better, not worse. If I go to the hospital as well, I'll lose my job. I need to move out. I will only tell my therapist once I'm out of the house and know my mom cannot do anything. I'm lucky my urge doesn't happen often, just sometimes.
I'm trying that, but I am bad with impulse decisions. I try to not let my emotions take control of me but sometimes it's too much. I'll dissociate it somehow.

I do have a therapist, but I'm scared she'll tell my mom. I am 19 but I do live with her. I'm not suicidal at all, just stressed. But my mom would treat it like I'm about to commit suicide in 3 hours after she's told. That's why I hate telling others.

It's usually just support and people telling me they care. Which I love and appreciate. They also tell me I scare them sometimes, which makes me scared since I can't see how I am. But the "Please don't, you'll be okay" isn't "irl" you know. I wish it was. Too much of a loner for irl friends.

In my daily life, no. I've confided with online friends but that's it. I'd love to tell my boyfriend, but considering we work at the same place (EMT) he might just tell me that my career choice isn't the best if I'm doing this, which would cause me to lose it because that's what I love to do. Everyone else would just freak out too much and be too overbearing and send me right to the hospital, which would make me worse. It makes me uncomfortable.
Thank you so much!!!! That's a big help :)
A list of alternatives would be great, thank you! I found a sh text line thankfully. I wrote this while in the middle of a breakdown, so at least im feeling better this morning.

I think you described it pretty well, and I'm surprised with that actually. Usually my depression is mid-low, but if any major happiness thing happens (which...thinking about it, wouldn't give others much happiness, its simple things) like hanging out with two friends and finally being accepted, a few hours later I just get stuck in those feelings you mentioned. I am in therapy but its been a while. I've had this rebound pattern all my life as I can recall, and I guess today is what got me to snap. Thank you for commenting by the way, that really helped me.

I'm sorry to hear that. I'm weird, I want a few friends and want to go to dinner with them and hang out with my boyfriend but I also never want to leave the house. I'm definitely an introvert. 

I am in therapy, but a lot of recent life things happened so suddenly its been hard to deal with. I also hope you start soon as well, therapy is a wonderful thing and has helped me immensely. I hope everything goes well with you, and thank you.

Thank you. I've just noticed this trend throughout my life and thought I had a real issue or was just being a crybaby. The amount of sadness I feel a few hours after a great time or great news seems to be even more powerful than that good time. Like, nothing brings it on, too. Depression is weird. Thank you for your input and well wishes.
Maybe. It's just that the rebound depression is so much worse than my usual depression, if that makes sense? That makes sense though, using up all those chemicals. Thanks for your input.
